race.comment: HERE COMES WOZZA (7) was a tad disappointing fresh up on his home track here, when blowing out of condition in the run home to finish ninth. He had won a jump-out on this course before that, and gets a nice chance to redeem himself in this. Stick with him. STEPIFY (11) did not beat much when doing just what she had to fresh up at Penola 18 days ago, scoring by a neck. She is up sharply in weight, but would have improved further since then, and she is capable of another bold run in this. ICE QUAKE (14) was back in form at just her second start from the Simon Zahra stable, finishing runner-up by a neck here just over 2 weeks ago. The winkers are on for the first time, and she can go one better. BOW RIBBON (15) has the pole position, and resumes off a short break. He has sound top 4 claims.
